mira: Heads-up 1: after the org policy change to forbid external key usage some SAST jobs started erroring with KMS AccessDenied when they try to decrypt pipeline secrets. Repro pipeline 4102. Anyone oncall?

owen: I'm oncall. Paste the job error?

mira: Log snippet: ```ERROR: decrypt failed: AccessDenied to key projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifacts-key
caused by: orgpolicy:deniedServiceAccountUsage
file: srunner/decrypt.go:58```

kaz: Interesting, the audit shows an org-policy constraint `constraints/cloudkms.restrictKeyLocations` combined with `constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains` tightening. It looks like the scanner SA is now disallowed by domain policy.

infra-bot: Saved audit diff and job artifact to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-3007/ for forensics.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2024-3007 created: "orgpolicy + kms -> sast decrypt failures". Paging @owen @mira.

owen: Short-term: we can add a conditional exception to the org policy for the scanner SA or move the artifact key into an allowed location. Which is faster?

mira: Easiest quick-unblock is an org-policy exception for the scanner SA for 1 hour so CI can run while we evaluate. I'll raise the exception request with the compliance guardrails (must include justification and TTL).

kaz: Long-term: two options - (A) update artifact workflow to use a KMS key in an allowed location and add a key rotation plan, or (B) change scanner SA domain membership to match allowedPolicyMemberDomains. I prefer A because it's explicit and keeps less special-case org policy exceptions.

owen: While we do that, add a pre-merge infra smoke: after any org-policy or KMS key change, run a tiny job that impersonates the scanner SA to attempt a decrypt on a test ciphertext. If it fails in CI we block merge.

mira: Agreed. Also add an alert: if >3 distinct pipelines fail with `orgpolicy` or `KMS AccessDenied` in 5 minutes, auto-create an incident and page sec-oncall.

kaz: I created GH issues: infra#4120 (orgpolicy-smoke-check), infra#4121 (move-artifacts-key-to-allowed-location), ops#4122 (kmsauth-failure-alert). I'll assign owners.

infra-bot: Applied temporary org-policy exception for serviceAccount:scanner@infra.iam until 2024-08-01T03:00:00Z; exception id OPX-2024-77 logged.

mira: After the exception CI pipelines green, no more KMS AccessDenied. Exported evidence to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-3007/.

owen: Follow-ups: (1) implement infra pre-merge smoke check that runs `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and a decrypt test under the scanner SA impersonation (2) implement migration of artifact key into allowed location (3) add alert rule for orgpolicy/kms failures (4) document org-policy exceptions process in secure-sdlc checklist.

kaz: I'll own the key migration (timeline: 2 weeks) and mira please draft the incident note for compliance with exception id OPX-2024-77 included.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2024-3007 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled 2024-08-03 14:00 UTC.

mira: Thanks all. Closing thread; keeping evidence in the incident bucket. :white_check_mark:
